content: {"phoneNote":"The hero photo is only half visible above the fixed bar and the first screen ends in a tall empty gap before it, while the two practice photos in 'Ljudje v ambulanti' are squeezed side by side with the arch photo running off the right edge.","desktopNote":"The hero with the circular photo and orange smile arc is strong, but the page leaks rhythm below it: a dead band under the hero, a large empty gap after the hours chart and after the people section, and contact details repeated in the dark block and the footer.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Phone hero: tighten the paragraph and gap so the photo with the children badge sits fully in the first screen, not cut by the call bar.","Phone 'Ljudje v ambulanti': stack the two practice photos full-width (or place one beside each person) instead of cramming them side by side with one clipped.","Trim the empty bands (under the desktop hero, after the hours chart, after the people section) and drop the duplicated address/phone/email from the footer so contact appears once."],"blockers":["Phone, 'Ljudje v ambulanti': the second (arch) practice photo is cut off at the right edge of the screen."]}
